articles.summary: NEW YORK – November 5, 2026 – Tradeweb Markets Inc. (Nasdaq: TW), a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes, today reported total trading volume for the month of October 2026 of $78.9 trillion (tn). Average daily volume ("ADV") for the month was $3.6tn, an increase of 26.3 percent (%) year-over-year ("YoY").
articles.title: Tradeweb Reports October 2026 Total Trading Volume of $78.9 Trillion and Average Daily Volume of $3.6 Trillion

articles.summary: LSEG and Tradeweb today announce the launch of RepoAgent, a new solution designed to streamline post-trade processing for the non-cleared repo market. RepoAgent, part of LSEG’s Post Trade Solutions business, is the first open access solution of its kind to deliver a straight-through, no-touch repo workflow from trade execution to settlement instruction, promoting the electronification of post-trade repo workflows.
articles.title: LSEG and Tradeweb Announce Launch of RepoAgent
